digest.component_or_area: CLI parser and route registry foundation (S2a)
propositions: A stdlib-only parser factory protocol and immutable route registry must be defined to enable safe migration of command sets without importing handlers or optional dependencies.

The route registry must represent all current command spellings with lazy handler/parser references and validate duplicates, contradictions, unknown capabilities, malformed references, and alias/retired collisions deterministically without resolving handlers.
Registry validation must prove that route construction and lookup import neither handlers nor optional dependencies (verified via subprocess isolation).

Derived compatibility policy exports must achieve zero shadow-census delta against current policy sets, with retired routes excluded from shipped surfaces but validation exercised on synthetic routes.

The ArgumentParser customization must produce deterministic, UTF-8 LF help output with fixed width and ordering independent of terminal, compatible parse errors, and non-terminating ParseError behavior.
